_doc: Lexicon entries (plan area 2, items 680, 759). Key: entry id as stored in GameState.records["lexicon"]. Granted by bonus goals (battle_goals.json "lore") or by a Wayfarer's "lexicon" key after a win.

cartographers.title: The cartographers
cartographers.text: Kestra's guild draws every road of Veydal again each year. A map that is not walked goes wrong, they say, and a Wayfarer who keeps all their Spirlings standing walks it best.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.text: An art can set off a status already on its target. Volt races through a Soaked foe, Gale blows it dry and slows it, Tide douses Scorch, Stone grounds a Jolt, Lumen startles a Drowsing foe awake, and Ember burns the roots off a Rooted foe but sets it alight. The battle log names every reaction it sees.

dual_elements.title: Two elements
dual_elements.text: A Spirling of two elements takes both factors at once: they multiply. Strong into both is x4, strong into one and resisted by the other is x1, resisted by both is x0.25. No hit ever does nothing.

rift_mystics.title: Rift mystics
rift_mystics.text: The mystics at the Tide Rift listen to the Hush instead of fighting it. They chain reactions on purpose, one status feeding the next art.

drowned_heart.title: The Drowned Heart
drowned_heart.text: The Hush gathered at the bottom of the Tide Rift into one heavy heart. It grows with every Spirling you field, so a full team does not crush it, it only meets it.

warden_orrin.title: Orrin's cover
warden_orrin.text: Orrin knows that Tide puts out his embers. That is why Shalebat walks with him: its Stone hide and Hunker Down take the Tide arts you answer with, while Kindlop and Smoldrake build up Energy.

warden_maelis.title: Maelis's cover
warden_maelis.text: Maelis knows her tide fears Volt and Bloom. Zephlet's Gale cuts Bloom down, and Zippit holds against the Volt Spirlings you bring, so her Riptail can wait for its moment.
